content.name: Kayla Brennan
content.title: Front-End Developer
content.summary: Front-end developer with nine years of React and TypeScript experience, the last four on employee-benefits enrollment used by 1,300 employers. Rebuilt the enrollment wizard so completion rose from 71% to 88% in one open-enrollment season. Strong advocate for accessible components and measurable performance budgets.

experience.title: Web Developer
bullets: Built responsive WordPress and jQuery sites for 25 local clients, from a brewery taproom to a county library system.
Set up a shared Sass component library that cut new-site build time from about six weeks to four.
Handled client handoff training, writing plain-language editing guides that reduced support emails by roughly a third.

experience.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Migrated the grocery storefront from server-rendered templates to React and Next.js, improving Largest Contentful Paint on mobile from 4.1 s to 2.0 s.
Built the substitution-preferences flow that let shoppers approve swaps in the app, lowering refund requests 18% during the 2020 demand surge.
Wrote Cypress end-to-end tests for checkout that ran on every pull request and blocked 30+ regressions in their first year.
Partnered with two product designers to define color, spacing and typography tokens shared by web and iOS.

experience.title: Front-End Developer II
bullets: Rebuilt the benefits enrollment wizard in React and TypeScript, raising completion from 71% to 88% for 1,300 employer groups during open enrollment.
Led an accessibility remediation to WCAG 2.1 AA across 140 screens, verified with VoiceOver, NVDA and automated axe checks in CI.
Created a Storybook design system of 48 components now used by four product teams.
Mentor two junior developers and run the front-end guild's monthly code-review clinic.

achievements.title: Company hackathon winner, Wabash Benefits
achievements.detail: Built a plain-language plan comparison tool that the product team shipped the next quarter.

achievements.title: Volunteer instructor, Chicago coding nonprofit
achievements.detail: Taught a 10-week HTML and CSS course to 18 adult learners.
